payload.content: Obsidian dev journal is at Brain/notes/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md (NOT Brain/journal/). Brain MCP brain_create_note writes to Brain/notes/ by default (good), but brain_devlog writes to Brain/journal/ (wrong path). When logging dev entries for this user, use brain_create_note with path="journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md" or patch the Brain/journal/ file manually into Brain/notes/journal/.
